title: Fruitbae Salt E-Liquid – Passionfruit Aloe 30ml
description:
Description
A unique mix of tarty and fresh passion fruit with a mild sweet, fresh taste of aloe vera, and a hint of mint to top it all off! Who would have thought that these two fruits surprisingly compliment each other extremely well? Not even the Magic Bullet can whip up a flavor like this!
Sorbae Salt E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Sorbae Salt E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
60% VG 40% PG
Introducing Bold 50!
In response to the new nicotine cap, Sorbae is now offering a unique hybrid nicotine blend crafted to provide the throat hit you know and love from the original 50mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, but are only 20mg/ml.
